description: Завод за јавно здравље Шабац: storm and wind hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open Data Portal Serbia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Завод за јавно здравље Шабац. Coverage: Завод за јавно здравље Шабац. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about storm and wind hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Analiza taložnih materija sa teškim metalima u vazduhu-oktobar mesec 2; Analiza taložnih materija sa teškim metalima u vazduhu-avgust mesec 20; Analiza taložnih materija sa teškim metalima u vazduhu-decembar mesec ; Analiza taložnih materija sa teškim metalima u vazduhu-septembru mesec. Formats seen: XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data License - Serbian Open Data Portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-serbia.
